vaccine for the Burning Death
had been completed and
animal testing had begun.
This was followed by the\nroadmap for mass-producing\nthe vaccine,
the indefinite suspension of the\nCS Project, and a rescue plan\nfor those in cold sleep,
as well as the reconstruction\nplan for the home planet of\nLevarance.
The people of Levarance were\novercome with joy.
